title: The ET-SoC-1, interactively
description: An interactive, animated schematic of Esperanto's ET-SoC-1 for presenting: the die with its mesh of shires, a shire's cache and minions, a minion's units, and eleven data flows played stage by stage (a load to DRAM, the latency ladder, TensorSend, the relay, gathers and scatters, the host over PCIe timed on three cards, a matmul on the tensor unit, the same matmul's watts and heat on different data, one hot line, the allreduce tree, and one value broadcast to every minion four ways) with the latency, bandwidth, energy and heat measured on three cards, each number with its source, what would settle each inferred part, and a 17-step tour for the stage.
